about_the_game: This is a simulation management game set in the world of Journey to the West, where players take on the role of a shopkeeper. In the game, you will manage and develop your shop according to the needs of customers, attracting various gods and monsters from the Journey to the West universe. By implementing clever business strategies, you can expand your shop, unlock more products and features, while experiencing rich storylines and interesting events. In addition to fulfilling customers' shopping demands, you'll also face challenges from competitors, handle unexpected situations, and complete various tasks and objectives. As the story unfolds, you will gradually uncover the commercial secrets of the Journey to the West world, experiencing a unique adventure in this classic tale.
